title: Neo4j Devcontainer Setup
description: Make Neo4j run zero-touch in the devcontainer and expose Bolt/HTTP so native Neo4j Desktop can connect remotely to the devcontainer.
summary: Implemented a single-container Neo4j devcontainer setup. Neo4j 5 Community, APOC Core, and APOC Extended are installed into the semio image, started by post-start.sh inside the semio container, persisted as APOC replayable Cypher under .repo/🛂/*.cyper, and published from semio on localhost Bolt/HTTP ports. Updated env defaults, MCP wrapper, docs, and removed sidecar/forwarder/raw-store assumptions. Normalized Docker names so the active container and image are both semio, removed obsolete devcontainer/neo4j/postgres artifacts and Neo4j volumes, and validated Compose has only semio, Neo4j starts inside semio, host Bolt/HTTP reachability, cypher-shell query execution, APOC runFile/query export availability, and mcp-neo4j-cypher startup.
